subject: Request: Custom per-token slab + retroactive credits for AstraNova
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Custom per-token slab + retroactive credits for AstraNova

Hi team,

Quick summary: AstraNova (prospect-turned-PoC) is asking for a custom hosted per-token slab and — importantly — a one-time retroactive credit to cover overage from June/July while they ramp their production rollout. They hit ~1.9B tokens in July, slightly above the standard volume breakpoint that would have given them a lower per-token rate. They are asking us to: (a) create a bespoke slab at $0.00090/ token once they commit to a 12-month minimum, and (b) waive ~30% of the overage fees for June/July as a gestural credit.

Attached: AstraNova_usage_breakdown_Q2.xlsx, proposed_commit_slab_v2.pdf (internal pricing sketch).

Why I think we should consider: they are a strong reference target in healthcare analytics, product-led adoption, and likely to convert to Dedicated in Q1 if serving patterns hold. Ben — can you surface the margin impact? Lauren — do we have precedent for retroactive credits like this, and if so, what was the approval path? Rishi — want your take on whether we can frame the credit as a one-time onboarding concession versus an ongoing repricing risk.

Recommend: Issue a temporary exception path: approve the slab contingent on a signed SOW w/ 12-month commit, and make the retro credit a conditional, non-recurring onboarding credit applied after they sign (no billing schedule changes prior to DocuSign).

Thanks,
Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Account Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Custom per-token slab + retroactive credits for AstraNova

Maya — thanks for the context and the attachments. I ran the numbers off the proposed slab ($0.00090/token) against their reported July volumes and our current hosted rate card. High level:

- If we accept the slab and the 12-month commit, the unit margin on hosted API drops ~22% compared to standard rate card for the first 6 months, then normalizes as their committed monthly baseline is consumed.
- The one-time retro credit of ~30% of overage (approx $12k) is materially small vs the lifetime value (projected) but does reduce immediate cash collected.
- Key lever: make the slab conditional on minimum monthly committed tokens (we should set a baseline of ~800M tokens/month) and pace the onboarding credit to be issued after the first invoice post-signature.

I support a conditional exception if Legal/Finnance approve the contract language and we add a clawback clause (credit recouped if they terminate within 90 days and don't hit the monthly baseline).

Happy to put a short margin sensitivity table into the pricing sketch if that helps sign-off.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Custom per-token slab + retroactive credits for AstraNova

Folks — quick policy note and precedent. We have granted onboarding credits in two prior instances (see Nimbus and Catalyst threads) but both had either (a) an explicit 12-month usage commit, or (b) an irrevocable minimum spend guarantee. Finance requires any retroactive credit > $5k to route through the pricing committee and get VP-level approval.

Proposed approval path:
- Sales submits a final SOW + signed reorder activity to HubSpot (link preferred).
- Attach the proposed clawback language: 90-day clawback if committed monthly threshold not met.
- VP-level pricing approval for the slab and for the credit (I can pre-approve for up to $10k on my signature; anything above that must go to VP).

If we structure the credit as a "one-time onboarding concession" and ensure it's written into the SOW as a post-signature credit, Legal is usually comfortable. Also suggest we limit the retroactive period to a single billing cycle (in their case, July).

Lauren Bishop
Head of Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Kiran Rao <kiran@astranova.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Custom per-token slab + retroactive credits for AstraNova

Maya — appreciate you escalating internally. Quick clarifications from our side before we sign:

1) The $0.00090/token slab would be grandfathered for the first 12 months as applied to our entire account, not only the committed baseline.
2) We are asking for the retroactive credit to cover both June and July; July is the big month but June had a smaller spike we want covered too.
3) We can sign the 12-month SOW asap if we get confirmation that the credit will be issued within 30 days of DocuSign.

We value Redwood's reliability and want to get this locked in quickly — we are willing to provide a short technical reference and to participate in a case study post-Dedicated migration.

Thanks,
Kiran
Kiran Rao
Head of Platform Engineering
AstraNova Analytics
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Custom per-token slab + retroactive credits for AstraNova

Looping back after quick sync with Finance and Legal. Decision and prescribed language below.

Decision: APPROVE conditional exception.

Conditions (must be in SOW):
- 12-month minimum term, with a committed monthly baseline of 800M tokens (explicit numbers in SOW).
- Agreed slab: $0.00090/token applied to usage above baseline up to 2B tokens per month; usage beyond that will revert to negotiated overage tiers.
- Retroactive credit: limited to June and July combined, capped at $15,000, to be issued as a one-time bill credit within 30 days after DocuSign.
- Clawback: If the customer terminates within 90 days or fails to meet 60% of the committed monthly baseline in two consecutive months, Redwood reserves the right to reclaim the credit pro rata on the final invoice.
- Legal to add standard audit and data retention clauses.

I'll shepherd the approval to VP for sign-off on the credit cap; please route the final SOW to finance-approvals@redwood.ai and include the attached pricing sensitivity.

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
